name: RC-B10-0545/2025 – After § 1 – Am 11
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text: 1f. Calls on the Commission and the Council to present a new architecture for European collective security, based on the principles of the UN Charter and the Helsinki Final Act in order to guarantee peace and security for all on the European continent;
